notes: Second update on 2026-09-28: (1) a sitewide Lydia input-field precision fix in shared.css, (2) Frame 11's checkbox-check-all behavior, and (3) a large expansion — Frames 16 through 24 — that merges the end of Priority Payments enrollment directly into a new invoice-approval sub-flow (previously the Invoice & Pay screens were a separate, disconnected flow; they're now reachable from Home's Priority Payments tab). No files were added or deleted this round, only edited: pp-review-enroll.html, home-connected.html, invoice-home.html, invoice-detail.html, pay-home.html.
lydiaFix: shared.css's global input/select/textarea rule was using the wrong border color (#C4C8CB, a generic border token) and slightly wrong padding. Verified against Figma's real 'Input field' component (nodes 7002:19187 and 7002:18529, and componentKey d482427e72aa1b0caa5c92bf7d95eef42f655ac9 in the 'Lydia -> Components -> v1.32.0' library): the correct border is #71828E (now `--input-border-default`), padding 4px 8px. Also discovered several search inputs (e.g. home-connected.html's 'Search bill provider' box) had NO styling rule matching them at all (they were scoped under `.field input[...]`, but those search boxes aren't inside a `.field` wrapper) and were silently falling back to unstyled browser defaults. Fixed by making the rule apply to `input[type=...]`/`select`/`textarea` globally, not just inside `.field`. This fixes every input across all 17 screens in one change. IMPORTANT for future work: Lydia's real component library lives in AvidXchange's private Azure DevOps repo ('ui-coe'), not any public package registry — there is no way to 'link' the real Lydia components into this static site; matching its Figma-exposed tokens by hand (as done here) is the correct approach for a no-build prototype.

conventions.stageConsolidationPattern: Where several Figma frames are really just different states of one screen, they're built as ONE HTML file with .stage/.stage.active panels (or a live form with real toggles/selects) switched by inline <script>, never separate page navigations. Used in: wizard-forward-email.html, wizard-login-credentials.html, wizard-enroll-accounts.html, pp-confirm-address.html, pp-payment-rules.html, invoice-detail.html, pay-home.html (row-select/detail-panel).
conventions.manageMenuHoverOnly: The 'Manage' side-card's non-active items are decorative: <span class="nav-item">, no href/onclick. Do NOT confuse this with the top TABS strip on home-connected.html (Connected bill retrieval / Priority Payments), which is a different element and remains fully functional.
conventions.crossFlowPersistence: invoice-home.html's per-row approval state uses localStorage (tsRow1Approved/tsRow3Approved) rather than a query string, since it needs to survive the round trip through invoice-detail.html. This is the only place in the prototype that persists state across page loads this way.
